title: The Danger of Being Easily Offended
summaryZh: 講員分享自己如何求神顯明心中隱藏的冒犯，並選擇主動放棄被冒犯的權利。
lines: It just doesn't bear the fruit of peace, of righteous living.
這就是結不出平安與公義生活的果子。
If I were to call out what I think is the number one enemy,
如果我要點出我認為的頭號大敵，
that I've seen at work in the body of Christ in the last two years,
就是過去兩年來，我看到在基督的身體裡運作的，
And it's connected to this right here.
這與我們剛才談到的有關。
It appears as wisdom. It comes with reason.
它以智慧的姿態出現，並伴隨著看似合理的理由。
Have you ever met a bitter person that didn't have a good reason?
你見過有哪個苦毒的人，是沒有充分理由的嗎？
It's their reasoning. Offense is that way.
這就是他們的理智。被冒犯就是這樣。
I've been on a little journey myself.
我自己最近經歷了一段小小的旅程。
I've mentioned it before and a few months ago,
我之前和幾個月前都曾提過，
but over the last, I would say maybe six months, I've been asking the Lord,
但在過去大約六個月裡，我一直求問神：
"Man, I don't want any trace of offense in my heart about anything ever."
「主啊，我永遠不希望心裡有任何一點被冒犯的痕跡，無論是對任何事。」
I don't want to live under that influence.
我不想要活在那樣的影響之下。
And to be honest with you, I'm one of the most forgiving people I know.
老實說，我是我認識的人中最願意饒恕的。
And that's an arrogant thing to say, but I really don't care at this point.
這麼說有點傲慢，但在此刻我真的不在乎了。
I honestly am so quick to forgive.
我真的非常快就能夠饒恕。
And yet I've asked the Lord, "Show me any place where there's offense."
然而我還是求神：「向我顯明任何有冒犯的地方。」
Because you don't have to be bitter to live under the influence of offense.
因為你不需要變得苦毒，也可能活在被冒犯的影響之下。
I've dealt with the unforgiveness stuff, as much as, to my knowledge, I have dealt with.
我已經對付了不饒恕的問題，就我所知，我已經盡力處理了。
But you can still unknowingly live under the influence of an offense and still not be bitter.
但你仍然可能在不知不覺中活在被冒犯的影響下，卻沒有變得苦毒。
Guard your heart. But you live under the pain of that when you don't need to.
要保守你的心。因為當你本不需要承受時，卻活在那種痛苦中。
So I've been asking the Lord to just show me this stuff for the last six months.
所以在過去這六個月裡，我一直求神向我顯明這些事。
At the most random times, I'll be just driving down the road,
在最隨機的時刻，我可能只是開車在路上，
and I will remember something somebody said to me in high school.
就會想起高中時某人對我說過的話。
"Really? Do we have to go that far back?" you know.
「真的嗎？有必要追溯到那麼久以前嗎？」你知道的。
Or something that was done in grade school, or something was done last year.
或者是小學時發生的事，又或者是去年發生的事。
I mean, just all kinds of very random things.
我的意思是，就是各種非常隨機的事情。
The conversation at the Chicago airport with a young man who had certain opinions and conclusions about me.
在芝加哥機場與一位年輕人的對話，他對我有一些個人的看法和結論。
I can see his face, I can take you where we were in the airport.
我能看見他的臉，我甚至能帶你去我們當時在機場的那個位置。
And I say, "I give up my right to be offended. I give up my right."
然後我說：「我放棄被冒犯的權利。我放棄我的權利。」
The lady who flips me off in the car, I pull over to have a conversation with her.
在車上對我比中指的那個女士，我把車停在路邊和她談話。
I give up my right to be offended.
The money that was stolen, the dishonesty in this deal, I give up my right to be offended.
被偷走的錢，在這筆交易中的不誠實，我放棄被冒犯的權利。
And what happens is you just have this stuff just dial up.
結果就是，你會讓這些事情湧上心頭。
Now I need you to understand, because there could be a horrible misunderstanding.
現在我需要你們明白，因為這可能會產生一個可怕的誤會。
I don't recognize anything yet He's brought up where I have harbored resentment or bitterness.
我還沒有發現祂所提出來的任何一件事，是我一直懷怨或苦毒的。
But there's something powerful that's done in my heart.
但我的心裡經歷了一件大有能力的事。
I don't know how else to say that.
我不知道還能怎麼表達。
Something powerful is down in my heart when I look at that.
當我檢視那件事時，我的內心深處經歷了大能。
The guy who met me at the airport here in Redding,
在雷丁這裡的機場遇見我的那個人，
and just read me the riot act on my eternal destination.
就因為我永恆的歸宿而對我大發雷霆。
